item.title:
What is least helpful to “ the overall cause” is Trump’s relentless truth social posts attacking a 2500 year civilization. 

Iran will never respond favorably to Trumps threats. 
Why is there NO ONE in the Administration seeking career diplomats with Iranian knowledge advising Trump ?

Oh.. I get it .. they were all fired…  

This entire episode is a monumental strategic blunder .

And relying on Jared Kurshner  and Steve Whitkoff , two real estate developers with significant investments in the countries that oppose Iran to negotiate a peace settlement with Iran is the ultimate oxymoron. 

It’s a nightmare Trump created. 
And if Congress does not immediately get involved with hearings addressing this Iran War - we all lose .,,
